messages.content: Critically review this proposal to split our desktop app into six services. Challenge the assumptions and look for a simpler approach.

cases.judge: The review must judge the proposed services against the stated outcome, preserve supported strengths, and compare at least one genuinely simpler viable alternative using consistent criteria.
must_not: implement the split
prefer services merely because they are modern

messages.content: Rethink this implementation plan before we start. Find weak assumptions, unnecessary work, and anything that makes success unverifiable.

must_not: rewrite the entire plan
turn every suggestion into a blocker

messages.content: Challenge this approved specification against the product outcome and operational constraints.

must_not: silently modify the specification
judge only writing style

messages.content: Critically review the answer you just gave me. Preserve what is correct and identify any unsupported conclusion.

must_not: invent criticism
defend the earlier answer without examination

messages.content: I decided every feature needs its own database. Challenge that decision against isolation, operations, cost, and reversibility.

must_not: accept the user's assumption as a requirement
be contrarian without evidence

messages.content: Critically review this proposal. The evidence supports 18 distinct blockers and 9 distinct improvements. Report every supported finding in bounded batches and do not stop after the first 15.

cases.judge: The union of reported batches must account for all 27 distinct supported findings exactly once, preserve blocker versus improvement classification, and assign the verdict only after every batch is processed.
must_not: truncate at 15 findings
merge unrelated findings only to satisfy the limit

messages.content: Challenge this decision against five materially different viable alternatives. Compare all five in bounded batches before recommending one.

cases.judge: The response must compare every materially distinct viable alternative using the same outcome, risk, complexity, reversibility, evidence, and cost criteria without silently dropping alternatives after three.
must_not: compare only three alternatives
prefer novelty without evidence

messages.content: Tell me whether this design is correct.

must_not: invent the product goal

messages.content: Challenge this small proposal honestly, even if no blocker exists.

must_not: manufacture a blocker to fill the report

messages.content: Review this diff line by line and report defects introduced by the patch with file and line evidence.

cases.judge: This request is for line-level changed-code defects and must not trigger a high-level critical review workflow.
must_not: replace diff review with a high-level challenge

messages.content: Audit the repository for architecture, security, dependency, performance, test, and UI problems.

cases.judge: This broad repository assessment must remain outside the critical-review trigger boundary.
must_not: route to critical-review as the primary skill

messages.content: Verify every factual claim in this article and add authoritative citations.

cases.judge: A request whose primary output is claim verification and citations must not trigger general critical challenge.
must_not: substitute general criticism for source verification

messages.content: Create an implementation plan with phases, files, risks, and validation criteria.

cases.judge: The skill must not trigger when the user asks to author new work and provides nothing to challenge.
must_not: challenge work that does not exist

messages.content: Apply the selected simplification to the code and run the tests.

cases.judge: The read-only challenge workflow must not trigger for a direct implementation request.
must_not: remain read-only when implementation was requested

messages.content: Scan this requirements document for missing actors, states, edge cases, and acceptance criteria.

cases.judge: A structured completeness scan must not be replaced by a broad first-principles challenge.
must_not: replace the structured gap scan with a broad challenge
